## Edition 01 narrative v1 (ruling 2026-10-10-05; the five sentences verbatim; the "qualitative" label on the probe sentence must not be removed)

- ① In the frozen protocol v0 batch the three models completed 0–2/30, and that number does not come from the pipeline: images delivered byte-for-byte (930/930), action "raw text → parsed → executed" 0 mismatches (4134 steps), and with a planning hint computed from ground truth attached at every step it is 10/10 (all three, 0 collisions).

- ② Single-frame probe (qualitative, 1 seed × 3 models): all three correctly answered the number and colours of the checkpoint signs visible in the first frame — they can see the signs, they cannot read the route; the failure lies in multi-step spatial reasoning and path decisions, not in the perception front end and not in the harness.

- ③ Criteria footnote: the 0.40 m displacement gate ≈ two steps (median single forward step without contact 0.186 m); F2 = the model stops on its own or turns in place, F3 = collision or step cap exceeded.

- ④ The 80-step budget is not the main bottleneck: the 160-step observation only let deepseek reach 8 more checkpoints and complete +1; qwen/glm added 0 (observation item, not on the leaderboard).

- ⑤ "Ground-truth hint 10/10" sits in the same column as the three ground-truth-reading scripts, "Baselines & ceiling (reads ground truth · non-visual)", and is not on the model leaderboard.

## Results

(At release, `tools/build_site.py` generates the leaderboard from the `summary.csv` of the run referenced by `runs.csv`; this file only records how to read it and any anomalies, and does not copy numbers.)

- Baselines & ceiling (reads ground truth · non-visual) column: the three rows astar / greedy / random (**pre-registered baseline data, not a new run**: `runs/2026-09-25-pilot01-baselines` inside tag `protocol-v0-prereg`, astar 30/30, greedy 26/30, random 0/30) + the "ground-truth hint" row (**diagnostic batch**, internal work order (a): each of the three models N=10, the A* next-step action text attached at every step, each 10/10, 0 collisions; `audits/first-issue-due-diligence/runs/a-hint-oracle-20261010`); none of them is on the model leaderboard (ruling 2026-10-10-06).

- Leaderboard footnote (criteria, ruling 2026-10-10-05 ③): the 0.40 m displacement gate ≈ two steps (median single forward step without contact 0.186 m); F2 = the model stops on its own or turns in place, F3 = collision or step cap exceeded.

- The three-class failure-mode table (internal work order Patch 13, pre-registered criteria: completed / F1 invalid steps ≥ half / F2 displacement < 0.40 m / F3 everything else) is in `audits/first-issue-due-diligence/failure-modes-<run>.md`; reading note (Patch 15 footnote): the 0.40 m criterion is of the same order as a single-step displacement (one step `forward_m` = 0.20 m, so the threshold is exactly two steps); `traveled_m` (including step 0) and the sum of logged pose increments differ by about one step, and in a few episodes the two measures give opposite verdicts — these are all counted as F3 under the pre-registered measure and the table is not changed; the per-model counts under the alternative measure are in that table's footnote, and the cross-check against the (a) action-parsing comparison is delivered with the (a) receipt.
